_meta.description: Prospector's shared ATS registry: companies, their job boards, and industry tags. Company facts only. See README.
attribution: Industry data for some entries comes from the People Data Labs Free Company Dataset (CC BY 4.0, https://docs.peopledatalabs.com/docs/free-company-dataset), from SEC EDGAR company submissions (SIC codes), and from Wikidata (CC0).

taxonomy.note: Prospector's own industry taxonomy (registry step, decision R5, 2026-09-10). Two levels: sector and industry. Names are ours; SIC, NAICS, the LinkedIn industry values carried by the People Data Labs dataset, and Wikidata items are crosswalk sources recorded per company entry, never shipped as the taxonomy.
